today_in_history_posts.title: Time to lower minrelaytxfee ?
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Five years ago, Bitcoin trading fees were reduced from 5000 to 1000 sat/vkB.  - A conservative reduction to 50 or 100 sat/vkB could accommodate growing LN adoption.  - Two years prior, a proposal to cut fees further to 200 sat/vkB was initially accepted but later closed.

today_in_history_posts.title: Dynamic Commitments: Upgrading Channels Without On-Chain Transactions
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Rusty proposes adding `commit_switch` and `commit_switch_reply` for double-opt-in channel upgrades.
- He suggests maintaining an initiator-only system to manage potential collisions.
- Upgrading to anchor_outputs involves three steps, culminating in channels requiring anchor_outputs.

today_in_history_posts.title: Thoughts on scaling and consensus changes (2023)
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Bitcoin aims to scale by developing 50,000 off-chain entities called "bitcoin banks."- These "banks" facilitate transactions, aiming for cost-effectiveness and security balance.
- Some proposed solutions include Utreexo, Coinpools, and Layer 2 protocols like the Lightning Network.
